englishPrep.label: Preparation before an English test
englishPrep.text: Pathway plans 8 weeks of preparation before your English test when you have no score yet. It never uses this time to decide that an intake is out of reach.

englishBooking.label: Booking an English test
englishBooking.text: Pathway's plan books IELTS, TOEFL and PTE at least 2 weeks ahead, so a seat is easy to find. The Duolingo English Test is taken at home whenever you are ready.

englishBookingShortest.label: The shortest time to book an English test
englishBookingShortest.text: To decide whether an intake can still be reached, Pathway allows one week to book a test centre seat, the time TOEFL's regular registration needs. It never assumes a faster booking.

defaultTest.label: The English test Pathway plans for
defaultTest.text: With no test chosen yet, Pathway plans for IELTS, which has centres in Dhaka and results within 5 days. Choose another test any time.

satPrep.label: Preparation before the SAT
satPrep.text: Pathway plans 10 weeks of preparation before your first SAT. It never uses this time to decide that an intake is out of reach.

indiaSpare.label: Spare time around the Indian visa
indiaSpare.text: Indian visa centres have been busy since visas resumed in June 2026, so Pathway adds two weeks of spare time.

englishValidity.label: When an English score is too old
englishValidity.text: Pathway counts a score as valid until the start of the month it was taken, two years on, and plans a new test if that comes before your applications close.

steps.title: Apply for your passport
steps.text: Every student visa needs a passport, and some tests and certificates need it first. A regular e-passport arrives up to 21 working days after your fingerprints are taken.
tasks: Book an appointment on the e-passport portal
Give your fingerprints and photo at the passport office

textWhen.text: For Malaysia, your passport must stay valid for at least 18 months after you start.

steps.title: Collect your passport
steps.text: A regular e-passport arrives up to 21 working days after your fingerprints are taken. If yours comes sooner, mark this step done.

steps.title: Prepare for {test}
steps.text: Practise every section under timed conditions, and book the test once your practice scores are steady.
tasks: Take one full practice test to find your level
Practise your weakest section every week

steps.title: Take {test}
steps.text: Your result arrives up to {resultDays} days after the test. Pathway counts the official result, which universities need.
tasks: Bring the same ID you booked with

taskWhen.task: Choose your four free score recipients before 10 p.m. on test day

textWhen.text: The University of Auckland and the University of Canterbury do not accept the Duolingo English Test for degrees.

steps.title: Prepare for the SAT
steps.text: College Board's free full-length practice tests in Bluebook are the closest match to the real test.
tasks: Take a full practice test in Bluebook
Plan your study around your weakest section

steps.title: Take the SAT {satWhen}
steps.text: Register by {registerBy}. Scores reach universities about {scoreDays} days after the test. The last test whose scores arrive in time is {lastSat}.
tasks: Choose the universities that receive your scores

steps.title: Finish your {exam} exams
steps.text: Studies abroad begin only after your final school exams. Pathway uses the published timetable, or the month of your A level series.

steps.title: Your {exam} results are published
steps.text: Pathway plans for the last day of the expected results period, so nothing depends on an early announcement.

steps.title: Get your police clearance certificate
steps.text: Apply online with your passport. Officially it takes 7 to 15 working days, but 4 to 6 weeks is common, so Pathway allows up to 30 working days.

textWhen.text: For New Zealand, the certificate must be less than 6 months old when you lodge your visa, so get it no earlier than that.

steps.title: Get an Indian visa
steps.text: There is no e-visa for Bangladeshi passport holders, so you apply at an IVAC centre. Processing takes up to 7 working days.
tasks: Fill in the form on the Indian visa website
Submit it at an IVAC centre
